audit.whatIsWrong: The page frames this as a hard 8/10 loss at every stage while Lux wins 54.29% over 1621 games, and the level chart gives Pantheon 7/7 rows.
audit.why: Pantheon is a genuine early bully (Comet Spear 575 range for 25 mana, Shield Vault 600-range dash-stun on 13s at rank 1) but has no answer to 1175/1100 range once Lux has Final Spark and an item. Difficulty is early-weighted, not permanent.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-5 Pantheon; Level 6, first item and 2+ items Lux. diff EVEN, diffRating 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] credit Pantheon at every stage including Late, and spikes[1] treats Grand Starfall as a lane all-in.
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 5500 range on 180/165/150s — a map tool, not a lane spike. Lux's spikes are level 6 (Final Spark, 60s at rank 1) and Luden's.
audit.corrected: Rewrote all four spikes around real ranges and cooldowns; late favours Lux.

audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATION repeated in whys[0], whys[1], whys[5], spikes[0], spikes[2], early, mid, late and wants.foe[0]: 'Pantheon's passive blocks your first Q or E'. Mortal Will does no such thing.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' The damage block is Aegis Assault (E) — a front-facing channel, 22/21/20/19/18s. Being a channel, Light Binding cancels it outright, and it is also an untargetable/invulnerable window that eats a badly timed Final Spark. None of this reached the page.
audit.corrected: Killed the passive-block claim everywhere; stated Aegis Assault as the front-only block, that it is a channel Light Binding cancels, that its invulnerability window should be waited out, and that Shield Vault opens with an auto-attack reset whose wind-up is the tell.
sources: enemyKit P/E text and flags (channel, untargetable, shield)
missingInteractions rules channel-interruptible, untargetable-dodges-burst, shield-absorbs-burst, autoreset-burst-tell

audit.corrected: Shield Vault 13s rank 1 / 9s rank 5, Aegis Assault 22s rank 1, Light Binding 10s flat.

edits.before: Pantheon's passive blocks your first Q or E from the front, so your poke is halved while his Comet Spear chunks you from range; if you step up to CS he W-stuns and Q's you for a brutal trade you can't answer.
edits.after: Aegis Assault — not his passive — is what eats your poke: it makes him invulnerable from the front for the channel. If you step up to CS he Shield Vaults from 600 and Q's you for a trade you can't answer.

edits.before: His R Grand Starfall global and W leap-stun make an all-in that ignores your range; Final Spark can't save you when he blocks the follow-up with his passive and leaps on top of you.
edits.after: Grand Starfall is 5500 range on a 180s cooldown at rank 1 — a map threat, not a lane one. In lane his Shield Vault leap-stun is the all-in; hold Light Binding for the dash, not the wave.

edits.before: Even with Lost Chapter your poke is unreliable because his passive eats a spell every few seconds, while his Aegis Assault E block and Q spam keep the pressure squarely on you.
edits.after: With Luden's your Q-E-R kills from 1175 while Comet Spear reaches 575. Aegis Assault only guards the front — root him from an angle and the shield never faces your laser.

edits.before: Pantheon falls off relatively, but in lane his point-and-click stun, poke-blocking passive, and dive threat mean he out-trades and all-ins you at every stage of the matchup.
edits.after: Pantheon falls off hard while your range does not. Late, his only way in is a 600-range Shield Vault on a 9s cooldown — bank Light Binding for it and he never reaches you.

edits.before: Pantheon owns the early lane: his passive blocks your first Q or E from the front, gutting your poke, while Comet Spear chips you and his W-stun punishes any step-up to farm - so give ground and last-hit from max range.
edits.after: Pantheon owns the early lane: Comet Spear chips you at 575 for 25 mana and Shield Vault dash-stuns any step-up to farm. His block is Aegis Assault, a front-facing channel, not his passive - last-hit from max range.

edits.before: Nothing improves at 6 - his leap-stun plus Grand Starfall lets him all-in past your range, and he simply blocks your combo follow-up with his passive, so hug turret and ward for his dives.
edits.after: Six flips it - Final Spark converts any Light Binding into a kill, and Aegis Assault is a channel your root cancels outright. Hold Q for his Shield Vault, then laser the landing.

edits.before: Pantheon eventually falls off, but for the whole laning phase his point-and-click stun, spell-blocking passive, and dive pressure keep you on the defensive; survive, scale, and rely on team peel.
edits.after: Pantheon falls off and you do not: late, he must cross 1175 range of yours to use a 600-range Shield Vault. Root the entry, slow the pit, and laser the clump - his R landing circle is visible to everyone.

edits.before: Block your Q-E poke with his passive, then Comet Spear you back

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Prismatic Barrier for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): 13s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5 — that window is your step-up. - Aegis Assault is 22s at rank 1 and it is a channel: Light Binding cancels it. - Your Q is 10s flat; never spend it on poke.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: Prismatic Barrier absorbs one hit, so spend it on the Shield Vault stun landing, not on Comet Spear chip — 12s at rank 1 is a long wait.

edits.before: Pantheon whiffs Shield Vault (Stun) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Final Spark is 60s at rank 1 — snipe the low walk-back, not the full-HP one.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Comet Spear reaches 575 and Shield Vault 600 — stand on the wave's edge with Prismatic Barrier down and he closes that gap free.

edits.before: Pantheon wins by landing Shield Vault (Stun), denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Pantheon wins by closing 600 range with Shield Vault while your Light Binding sits on its 10s cooldown, then Aegis Assault eats your answer.

edits.before: If Pantheon opens the score, reset expectations and respect Shield Vault (Stun) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with E clears and stay relevant through root picks.
edits.after: If Pantheon gets ahead, assume Shield Vault plus Ignite kills you from 600 range at any health. Farm with E from 1100, never walk past the wave's midline, and let Final Spark keep you relevant.

edits.before: Carry through the root-laser pipeline — one binding per fight, converted at screen range; your job is owning the geometry that makes it land.
edits.after: Carry by punishing his commit: he must dash in at 600, and Light Binding into Final Spark converts that dash into a corpse from screen range.
